fact.value: Proof of income, such as salary slips or bank statements
fact.quote: upload documents showing proof of income, such as salary slips or bank statements.

fees.value: Application fee is non-refundable if the application is disposed with rejection.
fees.quote: Application fee will not be refunded.

timeline.value: Returned applications must be resubmitted within 14 days.
timeline.quote: If your application is returned for change or to fill incomplete details, kindly submit it within 14 days of return.

issuing_authority.quote: In case of any wrong/misleading information provided in application shall lead to rejection of the application by Department Authorities.

steps.value: Log in to Digital Gujarat, select 'Income Certificate' and upload documents showing proof of income, such as salary slips or bank statements.
steps.quote: To apply for an Income Certificate, log in to Digital Gujarat, select 'Income Certificate' and upload documents showing proof of income, such as salary slips or bank statements.

steps.value: Click 'Apply Online' to file online or 'Download Form' to fill offline.
steps.quote: You will be required to click on "Apply Online” button for filing the form online or "Download Form" button for filling the form offline.

steps.value: Gather service specific details such as Occupational Details and Family details before submitting online.
steps.quote: Applicant should ready with service specific information like: Occupational Details, Family details, other than basic applicant details before moving with submitting application online.

steps.value: Fill all mandatory fields marked with an asterisk.
steps.quote: All fields marked with *(star) are mandatory fields in Online Application.

steps.value: Use the keyboard corresponding to the selected language (English or Gujarati).
steps.quote: As per the language selection English or Gujarati respective language keyboard should be used for filling an application form.
